text:
ava (PM): starting a focused thread: we need to finalize the "quota decay + elasticity buffer" behavior for Dedicated reserved pools. purpose: predictable customer experience during short spikes without overbooking capacity.

ava (PM): problem statement: customers reserve capacity but expect some headroom for brief surges. we want: deterministic decay of unused reserved quota, a small cross-tenant elasticity buffer, and clear billing/UX rules.

sam (Eng-Platform): proposal (short): 1) soft-buffer per-pool at 5% of committed capacity (configurable), 2) quota-decay where unused reserved units expire on a rolling 7d window but can be borrowed within 24h with debt tracking, 3) runtime checks: prefer committed tenants when buffer is contested.

marta (SRE): safety: buffer must not be used to break latency SLAs. if p99 rises >6% in 1m after buffer use, immediately revoke buffer admits and mark pool in conservative mode for N minutes. also cap buffer drain rate to avoid donor storms.

kevin (Billing): billing implications: borrowed-from-buffer should be metered separately as "elasticity units" and billed at a premium or deducted from next billing cycle depending on contract. we need clear visibility in invoices. also need an opt-in for customers to allow their reserved quota to decay (some want strict reservations).

nina (Customer Success): UX asks: show two numbers in Console for reserved pools: "Committed" and "Elastic available" with a tooltip explaining decay and borrowing rules. when a request is denied or preempted show machine reason codes: ELASTIC_EXHAUSTED, QUEUE_POOL_FULL, PREEMPTED_BY_COMMITTED. customers also want a toggle at onboarding: "Allow my reserved to be borrowable".

sam (Eng-Platform): runtime sketch (pseudocode):

```
// cached per-tenant: committed_units, borrow_allowed_flag, recent_use_window
// per-pool: committed_sum, elastic_buffer = floor(committed_sum * buffer_pct)
available_local = pool.free + min(elastic_buffer - buffer_used, tenant.borrow_quota)
if (tenant.committed_units >= req.size) ADMIT("committed")
else if (tenant.borrow_allowed && available_local >= req.size) ADMIT("elastic_borrow")
else QUEUE("pool_full")
```

sam (Eng-Platform): we'll store buffer_used with eventual consistency and enforce soft caps with optimistic admits + short reclaim window. short path should use cached integers, no DB on hot path.

marta (SRE): reclaim semantics: elastic admits are marked PREEMPTABLE; when preempting, pick the most recent elastic admits first and only preempt if donor committed capacity required. preempt rate capped per-pool: max_elastic_preempts_per_minute. alert when preempt ratio > 0.5%.

kevin (Billing): action: define metering label ("elastic.unit") and decide premium rate (suggest +25% over base committed unit). also need invoice line examples for sales.

nina (Customer Success): acceptance criteria from customer perspective: (1) Console shows elastic numbers and reason codes; (2) customers can opt-in/out to borrowable behavior; (3) examples in docs and sample invoice.

ava (PM): rollout criteria: (A) canary with 3 internal tenants — p99 uplift <=5% post-buffer use, (B) preempt events <=2/day per alpha tenant, (C) no more than 0.2% requests using cross-pool fallback, (D) billing labels visible in logs and invoice preview.

sim-bot: scheduled: buffer-sim job queued 1812345685 to generate 48h burst profile.

sam (Eng-Platform): tie-breaker: when multiple tenants compete for buffer prefer higher committed_ratio and earlier reservation purchase timestamp. discourages gaming.

marta (SRE): add circuit: if >10% of pools experience p99 uplift simultaneously, flip global conservative mode disabling elastic borrows cluster-wide until health recovers.

kevin (Billing): also flag: if tenant repeatedly borrows >X% of their committed capacity for >7d, switch billing to temporary overcommit contract and notify account team.

ava (PM): action items: sam -> prototype cached fast-path + buffer accounting; marta -> define concrete thresholds for p99 uplift, preempt caps and global circuit; kevin -> propose elastic billing rate and invoice examples; nina -> draft Console UI copy and onboarding toggle flow; i'll draft decision doc and customer comms. target: prototype + sim results next week.

nina (Customer Success): I'll collect 2 pilot customers who want buffer opt-in.

ava (PM): thanks all. keeping this thread as canonical for the spec. will post doc link here when published. :white_check_mark:
